description: This file defines a React functional component named `HistoryListContainer`, which manages and displays different history list tabs (Remote, Session, Legacy) for a note editing interface. It includes UI elements such as tab buttons and dynamically renders different components based on the current selected tab.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the props accepted by the `HistoryListContainer` component. It requires features, a noteHistoryController, and a function to select a mobile tab.

classes.name: TabButton
classes.description: A nested React component within `HistoryListContainer` representing each tab button (Remote, Session, Legacy), handling styling and onClick behavior.

classes.name: CurrentTabList
classes.description: A React component that renders the appropriate history list component based on the current selected tab.

methods.name: HistoryListContainer
methods.description: Main React functional component that manages the display of different history lists based on user interaction. It uses hooks like `useCallback` and mobx-react's `observer`.
